name: Emulator System Profile
description: Detects emulator environments through QEMU system properties, virtual hardware identifiers, build fingerprints, and emulator boot characteristics.

evidenceUnits.title: QEMU and virtual hardware system properties
evidenceUnits.observedObject: Bionic system properties associated with QEMU and Android emulator platforms
evidenceUnits.proposition: System properties explicitly declare QEMU or virtual hardware drivers
evidenceUnits.observationChannel: Bionic system-property API via direct syscall or __system_property_get
evidenceUnits.availability: Requires readable system property areas in /dev/__properties__
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: Root processes may modify or unset properties using tools like resetprop
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: Identifies standard emulator platform property configurations

evidenceUnits.title: Emulator build fingerprint and model characteristics
evidenceUnits.proposition: The system build fingerprint or product model matches generic emulator patterns
evidenceUnits.availability: Requires access to Android build properties
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: Fingerprints can be spoofed by custom ROMs or Magisk modules
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: Indicates build configuration origin; does not detect hardened hypervisor instances
